# Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] This PR only touches public release files.
- [ ] No private canon included.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, `.env`, or local private paths included.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Secret scan passes.
- [ ] Routes affected documented.
- [ ] Screenshots included if UI changed.
- [ ] Release notes updated if public behavior changed.
